items.title: Hospital group moves its warehouse to the lakehouse
items.author: Ana Ruiz
items.text:
A regional hospital group said on Monday it will move its reporting warehouse to a lakehouse over the next year, citing the cost of keeping two copies of clinical data in sync. The chief data officer said the project starts with finance and staffing reports before clinical analytics follow in the spring.
 Vendors were not named.

items.title: Short note on a payer rule
items.author: Lee Park
items.text:
A new payer data rule takes effect.
Payers must expose claims data through a new API by January.
The rule requires payers to expose claims and encounter data to providers through a standard API, with the first deadline in January and penalties after a grace period.
Providers have asked for this for years, and analysts expect warehouse vendors to market connectors for it within weeks.

items.title: Governed answers, generally available
items.text:
Every answer now shows the query behind it.
Starting today every answer in the product shows the query and the tables behind each number, and admins can require review before an answer is shared.
